newsitem.title: NIGERIA: Nigeria targets 30 billion barrels oil reserves.
newsitem.headline: Nigeria targets 30 billion barrels oil reserves.

text.p: Nigeria aims to raise its oil reserves to 25 billion barrels by the year 2001 and to 30 billion thereafter, Oil Minister Dan Etete said on Wednesday.
"This is to enable us take advantage of the robust demand for OPEC oil in the next century," Etete told an oil conference in Lagos.
"It will be unfortunate if this country cannot take full advantage of price improvement in the market for lack of spare capacity and also suffer losses when price falls," he added.
Nigeria's current reserves are 22 billion barrels with an output capacity of just over two million barrels per day (bpd).

Oil industry executives said while it was feasible for Nigeria, Africa's leading oil producer, to boost its reserves and production capacity substantially, the main drawback appeared to be funding the industry.
"Already they have big problems paying their share of expenditure for the joint ventures with multinational oil firms," said one.

Oil firms operating in the country frequently complain that Nigeria is well behind in the payments of the cash calls due to them, thereby delaying exploration activities needed to increase reserves and subsequently output.
Etete said the Nigerian government could not on its own succeed in raising the reserves and called for private sector participation.
"This poses a lot of challenges to the private sector, local and foreign to join the government for the achievement of the stated objectives," he said.

Former oil minister Philip Asiodu said investments in the upstream oil sector would need to rise to $10 billion by 2010 from the current $4 billion to reach the reserve base and exports necessary to sustain the country.
The money could only come from foreign sources and so Nigeria had to be make itself attractive to investors, he said.
"There is therefore urgent need to reorganise completely the structure and management of the energy sector in Nigeria," said Asiodu.
